title: Telephone telepathy experiments

tellings.quote: virtually everyone is about 85% of the population that you can do experiments on that have done lots and I'm pretty sure it's real

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake says people can often sense who is calling before they pick up the phone, and that experiments show it. He tells Michels he has done many of these tests himself, that about 85% of people can be tested this way, and that he is "pretty sure it's real." If he is right, minds would be linked in a way science does not yet explain.
